source_doc: Genuin for Brands and Advertisers - Publicis Health Media - GSK

entities.name: Matt Wurst
entities.description: Chief Marketing Officer at Genuin, listed as a contact on the deck (matt@begenuin.com).

entities.name: Daniel Harrison
entities.description: Senior Strategic Advisor at Genuin, listed as a contact on the deck (daniel@begenuin.com).

entities.name: Offsite In-Network
entities.description: Genuin's sponsorship program that extends contextual relevance and video distribution across the open web via partner publishers in the Genuin Network.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: Sponsored video post placement that extends contextual continuity across publisher destinations using IAB-standard 300x600 and 300x250 units.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: Sponsored content orchestration with journey takeover that configures funnel and relevance across a user session.

entities.name: IAB Compatible Session Takeover
aliases: Offsite In-Network IAB Compatible Session Takeover
entities.description: Full-funnel activation format that orchestrates partner ads and house ads in IAB-standard slots across a publisher session.

entities.name: Extended O&O Sponsorship
entities.description: Sponsorship format that maximizes relevance on every media impression by extending owned-and-operated sponsorship reach offsite.

entities.name: Genuin Network
entities.description: Genuin's distribution network of 300+ partner publisher destinations delivering 237MM reach and 4B impressions/month, extendable to 1.2BB+ programmatic reach.

entities.name: Contextual Activation
entities.description: Phase 1 activation in which AI matches video content to audience context across 300+ brand-safe network destinations without a data handshake.

entities.name: 1:1 Addressable Audiences
entities.description: Phase 3 capability that activates precision 1:1 addressable targeting on top of the contextual foundation, with closed-loop measurement via RMN/CMN data.

entities.name: Brand & Agency 1P Data Augmentation
entities.description: Phase 2 capability that layers brand and agency first-party segments into the contextual framework to sharpen targeting while preserving data ownership.

entities.name: Repurposed Social
entities.description: Workflow that imports existing social video assets, curates them on Genuin, and activates them across the Network.

entities.name: IAB Standards
entities.description: Industry ad-unit standards (300x600, 300x250) supported by Offsite In-Network sponsored placements.

entities.name: Pixel URL
entities.description: Pixel tracking URL supported by Offsite In-Network ad units for campaign measurement.

entities.name: GTM ID
entities.description: Google Tag Manager identifier supported as a tracking input on Offsite In-Network ad units.

entities.name: Google GCP
entities.description: Certified data destination for raw campaign data shipped back to advertisers.

entities.name: Amazon AWS
entities.description: Certified data destination for raw campaign data shipped back to advertisers.

entities.name: Oracle OCI
entities.description: Certified data destination for raw campaign data shipped back to advertisers.

entities.name: MixPanel
entities.description: Certified analytics destination supported for shipping raw campaign data.

entities.name: Snowflake
entities.description: Certified data warehouse destination for raw campaign data shipped back to advertisers.

entities.name: MMP Integration
entities.description: Integration that maps Offsite In-Network raw data against advertiser MMP, attribution partners, and analytics tools.

entities.name: Pay Genuin Direct
entities.description: Activation path where the marketer pays Genuin directly and Genuin invoices and resolves payouts to all network publishers.

entities.name: Pay Publisher Direct
entities.description: Activation path where the marketer leverages an existing direct relationship and payment setup with the publisher.

entities.name: Pay via RMN
entities.description: Activation path where the marketer pays their Retail Media Network and the RMN pays Genuin via a Genuin-generated invoice.

entities.name: Publisher Infrastructure Agreement
entities.description: Revenue model in which publishers pay Genuin for monetized infrastructure while advertisers pay zero infrastructure fees.

entities.name: Zero-Party Data Ownership
entities.description: Policy giving advertisers full ownership of engagement data (views, interactions, CTAs) shipped to their own infrastructure; Genuin acts as Data Processor, not Data Controller.

entities.name: 0% Tech Tax
entities.description: Commercial promise of zero infrastructure fees for advertisers, with 100% working media and transparent pass-throughs to network partners.

entities.name: Contextual Continuity
entities.description: Marketing concept of extending consistent contextual relevance for a brand's video across publisher destinations via Sponsored Post placements.

entities.name: Journey Orchestration
entities.description: Marketing concept of orchestrating partner and house ads across a user session for full-funnel activation.

entities.name: Full Funnel Activation
entities.description: Activation strategy spanning awareness to advocacy via contextually mapped content across the Genuin Network.

entities.name: Out-of-Market to In-Market Conversion
entities.description: Measurement capability tracking which audiences move from unaware to actively considering, with closed-loop attribution across publisher placements.

entities.name: Knowledge Seekers
entities.description: Audience segment reached through exclusive network destinations.

entities.name: Listeners
entities.description: Audio-oriented audience segment reached through exclusive network destinations.

entities.name: Diners
entities.description: Food and dining audience segment reached through exclusive network destinations.

entities.name: Readers
entities.description: Editorial/reading audience segment reached through exclusive network destinations.

entities.name: Brands and Advertisers
entities.description: Customer segment targeted with reach and distribution of video assets to engaged audiences in the Network.

entities.name: Retailers and Commerce
entities.description: Customer segment targeted with embedded video experiences that drive onsite engagement, product sales, and media revenue.

entities.name: Consumers
entities.description: End-user segment served personalized feeds with relevant content, offers, and social interaction.

entities.name: iHeart
entities.description: Network partner publisher cited as a pass-through destination for advertiser media payments.

entities.name: Grubhub
entities.description: Network partner publisher cited as a pass-through destination for advertiser media payments.

entities.name: Us Weekly
entities.description: Network partner publisher cited as a pass-through destination for advertiser media payments.

entities.name: NFL
entities.description: Example partner shown with placements across the network's exclusive domains.

entities.name: Publicis Health Media
entities.description: Health-focused media agency named in the deck title as the agency partner for the GSK pitch.

entities.name: GSK
entities.description: Pharmaceutical advertiser featured as the brand in the Extended O&O Sponsorship example on slide 14.

entities.name: Retail Media Network
entities.description: Retail Media Network channel through which marketers can pay and reallocate budgets for measurable outcomes.

entities.name: Commerce Media Network
entities.description: Commerce Media Network channel connected for closed-loop measurement in Phase 3.
